stable.title: DroidDeck 0.5.0
stable.summary: • Added SteamVR on Meta Quest 3 and 3S from the standard APK. Quest headsets are detected automatically and get their own driver defaults. Immersive SteamVR runs through a native OpenXR activity with headset tracking, Touch controllers and haptics, and SteamVR's dashboard and Steam library work in VR. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, @Jagger15, #642, #910, #733, #853, #905)

fix: clearing a game's compatibility tool in Steam keeps the Linux build
fix: Google sign-in from a store shows the real device instead of a Galaxy S23 Ultra
fix: browsers added as non-Steam games show their window and load pages in Gaming Mode
fix: a failing image or script on a store sign-in page no longer replaces the page with an SSL error
fix: a failed Steam client download ends the session with a message instead of silently

Your network or VPN may be blocking Steam's servers; check the connection and try again." with curl's error and the Retry button. Before, the session just ended and the launcher came back with no expla

recentPreviews.title: fix: GOG sign-in starts without the previous account's web session
recentPreviews.summary: Signing in to GOG again now shows an empty Email and Password form. Before, the login page stayed locked to the previously used GOG account, so a different account couldn't be used after signing out.

recentPreviews.title: fix: game files keep the full game name instead of cutting it at 40 characters
recentPreviews.summary: Game files (the .steam files written by Files → Sync all game files to folder and the per-game export) now keep the whole game name. Before, the name was cut at 40 characters.

recentPreviews.title: fix: file manager copy/move keeps symlinks
recentPreviews.summary: ﻿Copying or moving a folder in the file manager now keeps the symbolic links inside it.

recentPreviews.title: fix: cancelling a paste stops the copy and keeps a move's source
recentPreviews.summary: ﻿Tapping Cancel during a file manager copy or move now actually stops it.

tests.title: fix: keep controller focus after installing a boot movie; Xbox and itch artwork covered
tests.summary:
• Installing from the SteamDeckRepo list or the preview no longer drops controller focus. The button takes focus back after Install and after Use.
• Xbox and itch games are covered by the store artwork test and the docs. They use the same artwork editor as GOG, Epic and Amazon.
• Controller no longer goes out of focus in steamGridDB.

tests.title: feat: run SteamOS PipeWire and WirePlumber for gamescope screen capture
tests.summary: Remote Play from DroidDeck showed a black screen on the client: audio and input streamed, but there was no picture. Gamescope publishes its picture as a PipeWire stream, and Steam's Remote Play and game recording capture from it. The session never starts a PipeWire daemon, so gamescope logged pipewire: pwcontextconnect failed / failed to setup PipeWire, screen capture won't be available, and

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: fix: find GOG Galaxy SDK cloud saves when remote-config lists no locations
tests.summary: GOG games that use Galaxy SDK IStorage publish cloudStorage.enabled: true with an empty locations array. That is namespace default at %LocalAppData%/GOG.com/Galaxy/Applications/<clientId>/Storage/Shared/Files. DroidDeck treated the empty list as no cloud, so Manage saves showed "No cloud saves" even when the files were on cloudstorage.gog.com.

tests.title: [FIX] statx call on old kernels < 4.11
tests.summary: Fix statx call on old kernels < 4.11 for correct using of "Fast proot path"

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: Steam client download: resumes, retries, shows megabytes, and isn't paused out of sight
tests.summary: A user's first Steam setup never finished on an Honor Pad (Snapdragon 6 Gen 1, metered Wi-Fi with a 14 Mbit/s link). Their log stops at downloading Steam: binslinuxarm64linuxarm64 (2/17). The log was shared 31 s into the session, so nothing had failed yet. The way the download works explains why it never got further.

tests.title: Return to the launcher when a front-end game closes
tests.summary: When a game started from DroidDeck's Games tab (or from another launcher's link) closes, DroidDeck now ends the Steam session cleanly and takes you back to where you launched it, instead of leaving you in Big Picture.

tests.title: Switch the GOG store to GOG's official listing endpoint: fewer requests, the tab now opens in seconds
tests.summary: The GOG tab loaded one game at a time: user/data/games only returns owned ids, so every product needed its own requests for a title, art and details, and the grid stayed empty until the last one came back.

tests.title: a11y: give the button-like clickables a Button role for screen readers
tests.summary: Buttons, tiles, list rows and rail items across the launcher now announce themselves as buttons to a screen reader.

tests.title: feat: tools/device-smoke.sh checks a build on a real device over plain adb
tests.summary: tools/device-smoke.sh checks a build on a real device with nothing but adb, so a change can be tried on a phone or a foldable without python or a rooted device.

tests.title: feat: the unfolded game height can end at a fold line
tests.summary: The sizing rule for putting the game above a fold and the controls below it is now a tested function, so a posture-aware split on foldables can be built on it. Nothing in the app calls it with a fold yet, so there is no behaviour change today.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: fix: one refused thermal or power query no longer drops the others from the session report
tests.summary: The session report keeps the thermal headroom and power saver lines when the device refuses the thermal status query, and the other way round; a refused query now shows as "unknown" instead of removing the lines after it.

tests.title: feat: the unfolded controls can stay while a controller is connected
tests.summary: On foldable phones, the Steam Deck controls on the unfolded screen (trackpads and back grips) can now stay visible while a controller is connected. Turn on "Keep them with a controller" under "Controls on the unfolded screen" if you hold your phone in a telescopic controller and still want the on-screen trackpads and back buttons.

tests.title: feat: games show their logo, and store games get one from the store
tests.summary: Games now show their own logo. On the Games page the big title over the game's artwork is replaced by the game's logo when one is available (Steam games, games from GOG, Epic and Amazon, and added games), with the name still shown as text when there is none. GOG, Epic and Amazon installs now also bring the store's own transparent logo, and games that already had a cover (store games, folders with

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself
tests.summary: The install used to take whichever of Valve's three official client-update hosts answered the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest one. It now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used.

tests.title: fix: third-party GitHub mirrors only serve downloads with a trusted digest
tests.summary: Downloads that come with no SHA-256 to check against are no longer fetched through third-party GitHub mirrors. A mirror can no longer hand DroidDeck a swapped AppImage or Windows component.

tests.title: fix: Steam Controller (Triton) output/feature reports are no longer overwritten unread
tests.summary: Back-to-back output and feature reports from games or Steam to a BLE Steam Controller (haptics, settings writes) are no longer silently dropped.

tests.title: fix: a Linux runtime update keeps imported apps and catalog AppImages
tests.summary: Updating the Linux runtime no longer deletes imported AppImages, script apps and catalog emulator AppImages.

tests.title: Fix: Keep Android library names visible in diagnostic logs
tests.summary: Android HIDL library names such as android.hardware.graphics.mapper@4.0.so matched the email scrubber, so dependency failures became library "<redacted:email>" not found. Preserve these names only in library "..." not found loader diagnostics, including /vendor/ and /system/ paths. Generic text remains subject to email redaction.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: fix: manual cloud-save upload/download no longer reports a skipped sync as success
tests.summary: Manual cloud-save Upload and Download now tell the user when nothing was synced, instead of showing a success message.

tests.title: Keep visible external-display sessions running
tests.summary: Use the session Activity’s display power when suspending or resuming, preventing handset screen-off from pausing visible DeX sessions (#586, #741); Android 26/28/29/33 regressions and CI pass, and the signed build passed Thor secondary-display visibility and sleep/wake checks, with Samsung hardware validation pending.

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
